svg.title: Reconnecting Dunhuang - theoretical model
svg.desc: Theoretical model of Reconnecting Dunhuang: 16 entities and 19 relations in natural language across five narrative layers, with the authority records of each entity and the subject classification of the corpus, as recorded in the TEI file.
svg.text: 16 entities · 19 relations in natural language · 5 narrative layers · authority records and subjects from the TEI file
Together → Discovered → Dispersed → Institutionally separated → Digitally reconnected
Scope: most of the remaining Chinese
R19 is one documented case of R9:
the British Library holds this item.
R9 itself stays a general relation (◇):
the page does not say which items.
R1–R15 Direct: extracted or modelled directly from the frozen Wikipedia revision
R16–R19★ Enriched: supported by an additional authoritative source
(R16: a project interpretation; R17–R19: one documented item, IDP)
has subject: the corpus classified by tradition
not formalised — R9, R12: theoretical relations kept; no holding triple is asserted in the RDF
(the source does not say which manuscripts these institutions hold)
Repeated box (same number, “as in layer …”) = the same entity drawn again, not an additional entity
identifiers recorded in the TEI standOff
Evidence types (TEI taxonomy, also skos:definition in the RDF)
Direct — A relation extracted or modelled directly from the frozen Wikipedia revision, without implying independent historical verification.

Enriched — Enriched relation supported by an additional authoritative source rather than by the frozen Wikipedia revision. In this project: R16 is the project's interpretation of the International Dunhuang Project's (now International Dunhuang

Programme) institutional description; R17-R19 add one documented item, the printed Diamond Sutra of 868 (British Library, Or.8210/P.2), from the IDP catalogue and research articles. Each Enriched relation points to its own sources
(relation/@source, listBibl enrichment-sources) and is kept distinct from Direct evidence drawn from the frozen Wikipedia revision.
Natural-language layer: these entity types and relations are refactored into ontology classes and properties in the conceptual model.
Full authority numbers are printed for five entities; every record is in models/authority_linking_table.md.
Relations formalised in the RDF: R1–R8, R10, R11, R13–R19 (38 conceptual triples); R9 and R12 are not.
